name: Gnome Improvement
summary: After an adventurer brings him a ring he once crafted, recovered from the irradiated depths of Gnomeregan, Talvash del Kissel offers to upgrade the piece for an adventurer willing to supply the materials. Down on his luck in the dwarven capital of Ironforge, the gnome artisan combines silver, moss agate, and intricate lattice work to craft a far superior trinket.

sections.title: A Gnomish Artisan in Exile
sections.body: Talvash del Kissel is one of the many gnome refugees who fled Gnomeregan following its disastrous fall to the trogg invasion and radiation. Residing in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, Talvash finds himself down on his luck, out of stock, and desperate to prove that his talents as a master jeweler and tinkerer remain untarnished despite his exile.

sections.title: Upgrading the Old Band
sections.body: When an adventurer shows Talvash a ring of his own simple pre-fall design, cleansed of its grime by the Sparklematic 5200, Talvash is grateful but ambitious. Rather than letting a customer walk away with what he considers a dated, simple ring design, he insists on enhancing it. By layering a delicate silver and moss agate lattice over the band, he creates an improved piece that reflects his evolving mastery of metal and gemstone craft.

faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel is a skilled gnome craftsman and jeweler currently living as an exile in Ironforge. He ran a small jewelry shop in Gnomeregan before its fall, and one of the rings he made there can be recovered and brought to him in the Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the history behind the ring being upgraded?
aliases: where does the ring come from
faq.answer: The base ring is one of several simple rings Talvash crafted in his old Gnomeregan shop, later found on a Dark Iron dwarf in the ruins. After being retrieved by adventurers from the Sparklematic 5200 cleaner inside the ruined city, Talvash offers to modernise and embellish the plain band into a much finer trinket.

faq.q: Why does Talvash ask the player to provide the reagents?
aliases: why do i need silver and moss agate
why does talvash have no materials
faq.answer: Like many gnome refugees driven out of Gnomeregan, Talvash is struggling financially and has completely exhausted his raw material supplies in Ironforge. He lacks the silver and moss agate necessary to perform the delicate lattice work himself without a sponsor.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
faq.answer: The quest chain begins inside the Gnomeregan dungeon by obtaining a Grime-Encrusted Ring from enemies, cleaning it at the Sparklematic 5200 machine, and then following the engraved initials 'TdK' back to Talvash in Ironforge.

faq.q: Is Talvash bitter about his situation in Ironforge?
faq.answer: While he laments being stuck in what he calls an unjust financial hole, Talvash maintains high spirits and professional pride. He firmly believes that once he gets back on his feet, he will be renowned across Azeroth for crafting the finest trinkets anywhere.

faq.q: Does the Horde have access to this quest?
faq.answer: No. While Horde players can clean Grime-Encrusted objects in Gnomeregan, their version of the ring quest redirects them to an alternate contact, Nogg in Orgrimmar, rather than Talvash in Ironforge.

angles.text: This quest highlights the pride and resilience of gnome craftsmen, who refuse to produce sub-par work even while displaced from their homeland and stripped of raw materials.
Miners provide the essential raw materials—smelted silver and cut moss agates found in subterranean deposits—required to assist Talvash's jewelry work.
Taking place between Gnomeregan and Ironforge, the task reinforces the deep ties forged between Alliance heroes and the displaced refugees of the fallen gnome capital.
